title: Fern
description: Private photo capsules for your people. Collect everyone's photos, keep them hidden, and relive the moment together at a shared reveal.
bannerAlt: Fern campaign photography: friends sitting shoulder to shoulder by the water

title: Grove
description: Private memory that follows you across AI agents. Keep decisions, preferences, and hard-won fixes in one searchable, account-owned library.
bannerAlt: Grove campaign illustration: the sprout identity connecting four pieces of context

title: Fitr
description: A digital wardrobe built around the clothes you own. Co-founding Fitr with Adam and Mason, with SŌEN as your personal AI stylist.
bannerAlt: Fitr campaign composition: a rose hoodie, cream trousers, and silver sneakers

title: Burrow
description: Localhost, shared. Give your local app a public HTTPS link, receive real webhooks, and inspect requests from a terminal-first tunnel manager.
bannerAlt: Burrow campaign illustration: a local development laptop connected to the outside world

title: Fashion Vision
description: Computer vision microservice with 7-stage ML pipeline for fashion analysis. Four concurrent models for classification, segmentation, face parsing, and background removal.

title: Bramble Labs
description: The home for Fern, Grove, and Burrow. Independent apps and developer tools, brought together through a shared product identity.
bannerAlt: Bramble Labs campaign artwork featuring its botanical sprig identity

title: InkByte
description: Link management platform with URL shortening, QR codes, link-in-bio pages, and geolocation analytics. Monorepo with Koa API and SSR React frontend.

title: GoBox
description: Lightweight file sharing daemon for LAN transfers. Drag-and-drop uploads, password-protected links, and configurable expiration.

title: Paint OpenGL
description: A paint application built with OpenGL fixed-function pipeline and GLUT. 32x32 pixel canvas, BFS flood fill, HSV color system, and hand-drawn UI.

title: Sorbet
description: A lightweight C game engine and ECS library built with SDL2. Entity-component-system architecture, custom data structures, and a snake game demo.

title: Shrymp
description: My first attempt at a link shortener. The rough draft that eventually became InkByte.

title: Snake Game
description: A tiny but fully-playable Snake game that runs on an Arduino. Analog joystick input, 8x8 NeoPixel LED matrix display, and real-time game loop on embedded hardware.
